steps.body:
A: $(a^*+b^*+c^*)^*$ contains $a$, $b$, $c$ under a star, so it denotes all strings.

B: $(a^*b^*c^*)^*$: each single letter is an instance of $a^*b^*c^*$, so it denotes all strings.

D: $(a^*b^*+c^*)^*$: $a$, $b$ (from $a^*b^*$) and $c$ are all available, so it denotes all strings.

steps.title: The odd one out
steps.body: C: $((ab)^*+c^*)^*$. Every piece is either $(ab)^k$ or $c^k$, so an $a$ is always followed directly by $b$. The string "a" (or "b", or "ba") cannot be generated, so C is NOT equivalent.

Equivalent: any string splits into single letters, each matching a*b*c*.
Cannot generate "a" or "b" alone, so it is not equivalent.

pitfalls: (ab)* is not a*b*. It forces a and b to appear as adjacent "ab" pairs.
